- **Per-share consideration:** Upon completion of the Merger, you will be entitled to receive the Merger Consideration of $77.50 in cash, without interest, subject to any required tax withholding, for each share of Zendesk common stock that you own (other than any Unconverted Shares) immediately prior to the Effective Time, unless you have properly and validly exercised and do not withdraw your appraisal rights in accordance with and complied with Section 262 of the DGCL. [01_defm14a.htm#html:table:0040]
- **Stockholder approval:** (a) The Company Stockholder Approval Shall have been obtained. [01_defm14a.htm#html:block:01451]
- **Regulatory approval:** (c) (i) The waiting period applicable to the consummation of the Merger under the HSR Act shall have expired or been terminated, (ii) all required Consents and expirations or terminations of waiting periods (as applicable) under each Regulatory Law specifically set forth on Section 6.1(c) of the Company Disclosure Letter shall have been obtained or shall have occurred (as applicable) and (iii) the CFIUS Approval shall have been obtained. [01_defm14a.htm#html:block:01453]
- **Financing condition:** The obligation of Parent and Merger Sub to consummate the Merger is not subject to any financing condition. [01_defm14a.htm#html:block:00122]
